contract: This fixture is the instrument for Sprint 28c's acceptance sentence:
an experience must be reachable with NO code reference of any kind.
THE DISCRIMINATING PROPERTY, and the reason this fixture can fail:
every positive question is worded from its record's SITUATION and shares
NO content word with that record's PRINCIPLE. The pre-rescue store indexes
the principle (summary) and not the situation, so it CANNOT answer these
questions. A gate whose questions borrowed principle words would pass on
the broken store and prove nothing.
Records carry no symbol, no package, no operation and no snippet. Supplying
one to make an expected entry reachable fails the sprint by definition.

records.situation: when a nightly batch reconciles ledgers across time zones and the clock rolls backward for daylight saving
records.summary: Store every instant in UTC and convert only at the display boundary.

records.situation: when a support representative must explain months later why an automated decision came out the way it did
records.summary: Persist the inputs and the rule version beside the result, never the result alone.

records.situation: when a release ships on a Friday afternoon and the on-call rotation hands over during the weekend
records.summary: Gate the deployment on whether the person who can reverse it is reachable.

records.situation: when two groups own adjacent halves of one workflow and nobody is accountable for the seam between them
records.summary: Assign the interface one custodian and a written contract, agreed before either party tunes anything.

records.situation: when a number invented to diagnose a problem becomes the figure leadership reviews every week
records.summary: Keep the instrument separate from the target, or it stops measuring what it was built for.

positive_questions.question: our overnight reconciliation drifts by an hour when the clocks roll backward
someone in support has to explain an automated decision from months ago
we keep shipping Friday afternoon and then the on-call rotation changes over the weekend
two groups each own half a workflow and nobody is accountable for the seam
a number we invented to find problems has become a weekly leadership review figure
